still._prompt_note: Dani's shading tags and negative as the base (docs/art/pipeline.md). The warm-light negatives (orange, yellow trim) are dropped because the Scav is rust and amber; the hood, the olive and the dirt are weighted like Dani's accents; 'holding, weapon' are negative because the pipe is a prop still.
still._chosen_note: The Scav's still (shaded seed 8), re-dressed at cut time by recolor rules: cast.md wants the identical silhouette, and a new seed would not hold the pose. source/elite_scav/still.png is a copy of source/scav/still.png.

target._settings_note: The Scav's target block; the palette is the Elite's (black_l / concrete coat, red weapon, magenta eye), with rust0/rust1 for the boots.

rig._comment: The Scav's rig verbatim (docs/art/cast.md: identical silhouette). `recolor` at rig level re-dresses every part; the head keeps its own rules with the eye sent to magenta; the boots and the tape are left alone by the value cap.

cast.md: coat and hood in black and concrete grey (the Scav's olive, desaturated and darkened)

parts.name: weapon
parts._why: cast.md: a red-painted rebar cutter, its own prop still, hung from the palm like the Scav's pipe
parts._scale_why: only the head and the upper handle are kept (the lower handle is a discard: at a scale that keeps the whole tool the handle is under one art px); 0.85 makes that 20 art px with a 6x5 px red head
parts._rest_why: the prop still draws the cutter leaning 19 degrees to the right of upright, head up; 90 - 19 on top of the hanging arm makes angle 0 continue the forearm, head outward
parts._recolor_why: an empty list opts out of the rig-level re-dress: the cutter is red as drawn

recolor._why: cast.md: coat and hood in black and concrete grey (the Scav's olive, desaturated and darkened)
the rust shirt and brown trousers go to concrete: he is paid, nothing on him is a hand-me-down
